Four is a goblin child on the eastern most side of the Goblin Camp near the cliff where  Brawler Rancer is stationed.
“
You look like you think you're hard. Mess with us, and you'll end up like this bleeder.
„
— Four, threatening the party

Involvement

Act One

Four stands over the corpse of a dead adventurer along with two other goblin children. Despite his age, he proves to be overly aggressive, doling out threats to everyone who initiates conversation. If he is threatened in return, Rancer, Four,  Five, and  Eight attack the party. Killing any of the goblin children results in a quick surrender.

If the talking party member has  War Paint on their face, Four comments that they smell like they have been "kissin' a worg's backside".

Notes

  • Four is one of five numbered goblin children (alongside  One,  Three,  Five, and  Eight) who can be actively fought and killed by the party in plain sight.
This is a rare exception to the game's standard treatment of minor NPCs; human and tiefling children can only be  Knocked Out, and any narrative deaths they suffer (such as during the Raid on the Emerald Grove) occur strictly off-screen.
